steps.command: wp option update blogname 'WP Dansal demo'

steps.code:
<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

// wp-dansal Playground demo (#131): seeds purely local sample content — no
// dansal connection or API key is configured, so the plugin never makes an
// outbound call. Dates are computed relative to "now" so the demo always
// shows upcoming events, whenever it's actually launched.

if ( ! post_type_exists( 'dansal_location' ) || ! post_type_exists( 'dansal_event' ) ) {
	return; // Plugin isn't active for some reason — nothing to seed.
}

function wpd_demo_location( $title, array $meta ) {
	$post_id = wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_type'   => 'dansal_location',
			'post_status' => 'publish',
			'post_title'  => $title,
		)
	);
	foreach ( $meta as $key => $value ) {
		update_post_meta( $post_id, $key, $value );
	}
	return $post_id;
}

function wpd_demo_event( $title, $description, $days_from_now, $start_time, $end_time, $location_post_id, $tag ) {
	$post_id = wp_insert_post(
		array(
			'post_type'    => 'dansal_event',
			'post_status'  => 'publish',
			'post_title'   => $title,
			'post_content' => $description,
		)
	);
	$date = gmdate( 'Y-m-d', strtotime( "+{$days_from_now} days" ) );
	update_post_meta( $post_id, '_wpd_start_time', $date . 'T' . $start_time );
	update_post_meta( $post_id, '_wpd_end_time', $date . 'T' . $end_time );
	update_post_meta( $post_id, '_wpd_location_post_id', $location_post_id );
	update_post_meta( $post_id, '_wpd_tags', ',' . $tag . ',' );
	update_post_meta( $post_id, '_wpd_is_cancelled', '' );
	return $post_id;
}

// Fake, never-transmitted ids: only used locally to link the room to its
// building (WPD_CPT_Location::is_room()/parent_post_id()) — there is no
// dansal connection configured, so these never leave this WordPress install.
$building = wpd_demo_location(
	'Kulturzentrum Nordstadt',
	array(
		'_wpd_short_name'      => 'Kulturzentrum',
		'_wpd_address'         => 'Beispielstraße 12',
		'_wpd_zipcode'         => '50667',
		'_wpd_town'            => 'Köln',
		'_wpd_country'         => 'Germany',
		'_wpd_country_code'    => 'DE',
		'_wpd_latitude'        => '50.9375',
		'_wpd_longitude'       => '6.9603',
		'_wpd_floor_condition' => 'parquet',
		'_wpd_attr_wheelchair' => '1',
		'_wpd_attr_bar'        => '1',
		'_wpd_dansal_id'       => 900001,
	)
);

$room = wpd_demo_location(
	'Großer Saal',
	array(
		'_wpd_address'          => 'Beispielstraße 12',
		'_wpd_zipcode'          => '50667',
		'_wpd_town'             => 'Köln',
		'_wpd_latitude'         => '50.9375',
		'_wpd_longitude'        => '6.9603',
		'_wpd_floor_condition'  => 'parquet',
		'_wpd_dansal_id'        => 900002,
		'_wpd_parent_dansal_id' => 900001,
	)
);

$second_building = wpd_demo_location(
	'Tanzhaus am Rhein',
	array(
		'_wpd_address'      => 'Uferweg 3',
		'_wpd_zipcode'      => '53111',
		'_wpd_town'         => 'Bonn',
		'_wpd_country'      => 'Germany',
		'_wpd_country_code' => 'DE',
		'_wpd_latitude'     => '50.7359',
		'_wpd_longitude'    => '7.0906',
		'_wpd_dansal_id'    => 900003,
	)

wpd_demo_event(
	'Balfolk-Abend',
	'Ein entspannter Balfolk-Abend mit Livemusik.',
	3,
	'20:00',
	'23:30',
	$room,
	'bal-folk'
);

wpd_demo_event(
	'Workshop: Mazurka für Einsteiger',
	'Ein Einsteiger-Workshop rund um die Mazurka.',
	7,
	'18:00',
	'20:00',
	$building,
	'workshop'

wpd_demo_event(

	'Ein Wochenendfestival mit mehreren Workshops und Bällen.',
	21,
	'10:00',
	'23:00',
	$second_building,
